## What Kind of Issue Is This?

<!-- Mark one with an x. -->

- [ ] **Content error:** a definition, a table, a callout, a diagram or a flash card is wrong
- [ ] **Outdated content:** PeopleCert has changed the exam or the ITIL 4 scheme since this was written
- [ ] **Exam coverage:** the notes don't match the ITIL 4 Foundation candidate syllabus
- [ ] **Site bug:** search, navigation, diagrams, a broken link or accessibility
- [ ] **Device issue:** something looks wrong or doesn't work on a specific device, browser or screen size
- [ ] **Suggestion:** something could be clearer or easier to study

## Where?

<!-- Paste a link to the page or section. Click the section in the page's Table of Contents, or hover over a heading and click the link icon beside it, then copy the address bar. -->

## What Is Wrong?

<!-- Quote what the notes say, or describe what happened. For a bug or device issue, list the steps to reproduce it. -->

## What Should It Be?

<!-- Give the correct information, or what you expected to happen. -->

## Official Source

<!-- For content issues, cite the source that supports this, such as a page or section of the official ITIL 4 Foundation book, the PeopleCert ITIL 4 Foundation page (https://www.peoplecert.org/browse-certifications/it-governance-and-service-management/ITIL-1/itil-4-foundation-2565) or the PeopleCert ITIL FAQ (https://www.peoplecert.org/help-and-support/faq-itil). A short reference is enough, so there's no need to copy long passages from the book. -->
